name: Shearilicine

name: Tryptamine pyrroloindolines
reason: Target set explicitly includes (+)-calycanthine. Primary pharmacology identifies calycanthine as a central convulsant acting through GABA release and GABA-A currents. Excluded per user target-risk filter.

name: Halenaquinone 等
reason: Multi-target paper reports several natural products with cytotoxic IC50 below 1 micromolar; orhalquinone mean about 0.8 micromolar across four colon cancer lines. Halenaquinone itself exceeds 50 micromolar; exclusion applies to the paper multi-target scope, not all family members.
